# Battle Phase Indicator

Battle · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/battle-phase-indicator`

Real consumers: **1** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

A controlled, oriented comet marker for the five presentation-level battle phases.

> **Guidance:** Advance battle state outside this indicator and pass the current phase and viewer-relative side.

Track position, glyph, motion, reduced-motion treatment, and accessible naming stay component-owned.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phase` | `"dawn" \| "day" \| "dusk" \| "night" \| "challenge"` | yes | — | Controlled visible phase. |
| `side` | `"near" \| "far"` | yes | — | Status-edge orientation from the viewer's perspective. |

## Usage

```tsx
<BattlePhaseIndicator phase={phase} side="near" />
```
